dt: Last solicited in ROSES-2024 (element D.15; proposals were due Mar 20, 2025); not in ROSES-2025. NASA plans to release ROSES-27 no later than January 2027.
e: Supports US investigators doing research that prepares for LISA science. The FY2027 budget request would cut Physics of the Cosmos to $3.8M.
unv: NASA has not said whether ROSES-27 will include LISA Preparatory Science.
